facts.fact: The home affairs minister said Namibia's electronic identity document, an app or smart card that verifies a person online or in person, is expected to launch in the 2026/27 financial year, for use in government and the private sector.

systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security

NAM.note: Birth certificates and IDs are counted separately; no link stated.

facts.fact: The home affairs minister said the government issued 117,175 national IDs in 2025, with the electronic ID still to launch in 2026/27.
